tasks.title: Wire config + routing helpers for tmux worker backend into orchestrator.spawn_agent
acceptance_criteria: `harness/orchestrator.py` defines `_claude_backend(config: dict) -> str` returning the configured `workers.claude_backend` string, defaulting to `headless` when the key (or `workers` table) is absent.

`harness/orchestrator.py` defines `_use_tmux_claude(agent: str, config: dict) -> bool` returning True only when `_claude_backend(config) == 'tmux'` AND the agent is the claude worker; False otherwise (headless backend, or non-claude agent).

`spawn_agent` gains a purely additive, flag-gated branch: when `_use_tmux_claude(agent, config)` is True it lazily imports `harness.tmux_worker` and delegates to `spawn_claude_tmux(agent, resolved_prompt, env, config, dbus_sock=...)`, returning its `_ExitedProc` so the existing proc-handling contract (poll/returncode/wait/kill/_work_dir) is honored.
The lazy `import harness.tmux_worker` happens only inside the gated branch (no module-level import), so the default headless path never imports tmux_worker.
`harness/config.yaml` gains a `workers.claude_backend: headless` entry, with an adjacent comment whose text contains the literal token `tmux_worker`.

No existing `spawn_agent` branch is removed or rewritten; the headless path, the agy STDIN path, the synthesis `active_agents`, and all `agents.*` entries are byte-for-byte unchanged; the default backend remains `headless` (not flipped to `tmux`).
tasks.verification_command: python -c "import harness.orchestrator as o; assert hasattr(o,'_claude_backend') and hasattr(o,'_use_tmux_claude')"

spec.objective: Add the configuration read + routing seam that lets the orchestrator conditionally delegate claude worker execution to the tmux worker backend, gated behind a config flag whose default keeps current behavior. This is a SENSITIVE-path edit (`harness/orchestrator.py`, `harness/config.yaml` under `_SENSITIVE_APPLY_GLOBS = harness/**, config/**`) and is therefore classified `harness_self_fix`.
functional_requirements: `_claude_backend(config: dict) -> str`: read `config['workers']['claude_backend']` and return it as a string; return `'headless'` when `workers` or `claude_backend` is missing/None, treating absence as the safe default.

`_use_tmux_claude(agent: str, config: dict) -> bool`: return True only when `_claude_backend(config) == 'tmux'` and `agent` is the claude worker agent; otherwise False (covers headless backend and non-claude agents).

In `spawn_agent`, add a new conditional branch guarded by `_use_tmux_claude(agent, config)` that lazily imports `harness.tmux_worker` and returns `spawn_claude_tmux(agent, resolved_prompt, env, config, dbus_sock=...)`'s `_ExitedProc`.
Add `workers.claude_backend: headless` to `harness/config.yaml` with a neighboring comment that contains the literal substring `tmux_worker`.

Preserve all existing `spawn_agent` branches additively and keep the default backend `headless`; do not change the headless path, agy STDIN path, synthesis `active_agents`, or any `agents.*` entry, and do not flip the default to `tmux`.
spec.interfaces: Adds `_claude_backend(config: dict) -> str` and `_use_tmux_claude(agent: str, config: dict) -> bool` to `harness/orchestrator.py`. Consumes `harness.tmux_worker.spawn_claude_tmux(agent, resolved_prompt, env, config, *, dbus_sock=None) -> _ExitedProc` where `_ExitedProc` supports `poll() -> 0`, `returncode == 0`, `wait(timeout=None) -> 0`, `kill()` (no-op), and an assignable `_work_dir`. The delegated proc is returned to `spawn_agent`'s caller unchanged.
edge_cases: `config` missing the `workers` table entirely -> backend defaults to `headless`, routing returns False.
`workers` present but `claude_backend` absent or None -> defaults to `headless`.
`claude_backend: tmux` but `agent` is not the claude worker (e.g. agy/non-claude) -> `_use_tmux_claude` returns False, headless/STDIN path is taken.
`claude_backend` set to an unrecognized string -> not equal to `'tmux'`, so routing returns False (no delegation).
tmux branch must lazily import so that importing `harness.orchestrator` with the default config never imports `harness.tmux_worker`.
non_goals: INTEGRATION-TEST EXCUSE (REQUIRED verbatim in every generated task's `spec.non_goals`): live end-to-end integration of this backend (spawning a real interactive claude in tmux for a real worker task) is an OPERATOR-VALIDATED step performed AFTER merge by flipping the flag; it is deliberately OUT OF SCOPE for automated leaf tests, which exercise pure seams over injected fakes only (no real tmux/claude spawn in any test). This excuses the `missing_integration_test` plan gate.
Do NOT change the headless path, the agy STDIN path, the synthesis `active_agents`, or any `agents.*` entry.
Do NOT remove or rewrite any existing `spawn_agent` branch; the new branch is purely additive and flag-gated.
Do NOT flip the default to `tmux` here (operator does it after live validation).
Do NOT touch NGv2 (the agy-default hunt is the separate epic `ngv2_agy_default_hunt`).
Do NOT scrape the TUI for the deliverable; the deliverable is the outbox files claude writes.
spec.implementation_notes: Place `_claude_backend` and `_use_tmux_claude` near the other private orchestrator helpers. Keep the `import harness.tmux_worker` inside the gated branch in `spawn_agent` (lazy) to avoid a module-level dependency and to keep the default path import-clean. Mirror how `spawn_agent` resolves `resolved_prompt`, `env`, and `dbus_sock` for the other branches when forwarding to `spawn_claude_tmux`. In `config.yaml`, add the `workers:` table (or extend it) with `claude_backend: headless` and an inline/adjacent comment mentioning `tmux_worker` so the flag is discoverable. Make zero edits outside the additive helper definitions, the single new gated branch, and the one config line+comment.

test_spec.test_data_requirements: In-memory config dicts covering: no `workers` table, `workers` without `claude_backend`, `claude_backend: headless`, `claude_backend: tmux`, and an unrecognized backend string. A fake `spawn_claude_tmux` returning a fake `_ExitedProc` (poll->0, returncode 0, wait->0, kill no-op, assignable `_work_dir`) injected via monkeypatch on `harness.tmux_worker`. No real tmux/claude process is spawned.

token_budget_ratio.note: Small additive change (two helpers + one gated branch + one config line). Test effort dominates because the routing truth table and the no-regression guarantees must be pinned over injected fakes.
